title: Flashpoint update - Find the truth
body:
# Flashpoint update - Find the truth

Raiders,

Celeste's radar is filling up with unidentified signatures.

Scouts are already working fast to size up these new threats, and word going around the tubes hints that your usual tactics might not cut it anymore.

Shredders are breaking free of containment, a new laser-equipped ARC type is patrolling the skies, and large, unarmed machines are touching down in controlled landings across the grounds. Their hulls likely hold salvageable resources. It won't be simple, but with some new weapons in your backpack and an appetite for fresh loot, why would you pass it up?

**The Flashpoint Update goes live on March 31st!**

# ARC Operation: Close Scrutiny

What is that? A quick descent, a controlled touchdown... a Probe? It's too big for that. It seems to hold its position, showing no obvious aggression - at least not from the object itself. The ARC patrols escorting it are unlike anything seen before. Celeste has named it the **Assessor**. She wants answers about its purpose, and Raiders want whatever it's carrying. One goal serves both.

**ARC Operations** are a new category of major map condition, and **Close Scrutiny** is not a gentle introduction. Loot around the map becomes scarcer, but the contents of the **ARC Assessor** could make up for it. Bring your strongest gear and prepare for combat.

# New ARC Threat: Vaporizer

Whatever purpose the Assessor serves, it must matter a great deal. A new flying ARC unit has been seen prowling the zones near the operation. It has already gained a reputation among Raiders for its brutal laser attacks and unpredictable movement patterns. They call it the **Vaporizer**.

# New Weapons and Items

Tian Wen keeps to herself as usual, but lately she's been more withdrawn than ever. Late-night sounds of welding and swearing have drifted from her workshop as she works on new weapons and gadgets. Now it's time to track down the Blueprints and try them out.

## **Canto**

The **Canto** is a submachine gun that holds its own against ARC in tight-quarters fighting. It fires medium ammunition and keeps both machines and opportunistic Raiders at a safe distance.

## **Dolabra**

The **Dolabra** gives Raiders a fresh method for breaking through ARC armor plating up close. This energy shotgun has a variable focus setting, letting you choose between a wide burst or a concentrated stream of electricity. Your best shot at finding this Blueprint is during the Close Scrutiny ARC Operation.

## **Surge Coil**

Better safe than sorry. Sometimes you need the reassurance that no one can sneak up on you while your attention is elsewhere. The **Surge Coil** is a deployable device that periodically charges its surroundings with electricity, shocking anything that comes too close.

# New Project: High Gain Antenna

Rumors, radar blips, recordings - the information reaching Speranza keeps troubling Celeste. Raiders have been trading stories about odd shapes in the sky during the hurricane, but where did they come from, and where are they going?

Celeste and Shani need eyes in the sky. Expect them to ask for help collecting important resources to build a **High Gain Antenna**. Your effort will be rewarded, but what they're tracking is a danger to everyone - it's time to pitch in.

# Scrappy: Feeding Boost

Your bond with your raiding rooster has grown stronger, and you can now expand the types of loot Scrappy gathers by feeding him specific items. In return for your generosity, Scrappy will drop more valuable items as long as you keep feeding him.

# Spreading Shredders

Someone left the Stella Montis doors open behind them. Stay alert on Blue Gate, Buried City, Spaceport, and Dam Battlegrounds during map conditions - the floating threat has been spotted throughout the Rust Belt.

# Crafting improvements

We understand that assembling the perfect loadout takes time, when what you really want is to be out raiding. That's why we're rolling out useful improvements to the crafting system to speed up your time in Speranza. When crafting, Raiders can now fulfill missing materials directly, cutting down on switching between tabs. When materials are missing, Raiders will see a list of available sources, allowing you to recycle, refine, or purchase all from a single window.

# New bundle: The Wasp Hunter Set

Our second cosmetic bundle is now available for purchase on all platforms! The Wasp Hunter tears ARC apart limb by limb, harvesting the parts to build a mechanistic outfit designed to keep enemies guessing. The set includes **four unique colorways**, the **Diver Backpack (White)**, a new **Scrappy Helmet**, the **Thruster Hammer Raider Tool**, and **2400 Raider Tokens** on top of it all!

# Cosmetics

You'll want some new gear for this new season. Throughout April, we'll release three new outfits at intervals: The **Brigade Set** brings the determination of a Roman centurion into the modern day, featuring a stylish bomber jacket, a kerchief, and piercing blue eyes. The **Vanguard Set** prepares you for chaos, whether that's a swarm of Ticks or hostile Raiders. The **Nascosto Set** is built for those who prefer to vanish, with a ghillie-style hood and shoulder pads suited to a shoot-and-disappear approach.

As always, good luck up there, Raiders.

The ARC Raiders Team
